source_row.rationale: Recognized risk factors for uterine atony include prolonged labor, an overdistended uterus (such as from multiple gestation, polyhydramnios, or macrosomia), and grand multiparity, informing individualized risk assessment and preparedness.
source_row.source_detail: Recognized Risk Factors for Uterine Atony
